name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys developed a keen eye for detail early in life, helping his father rebuild classic cars in their Wellington garage. This hands-on experience ignited a passion for motorsport and a relentless pursuit of perfection. After completing his mechanical engineering degree, Rhys honed his skills at a local racing team before landing a role with Brad Jones Racing. 

Rhys approaches quality control with an analytical mind and unwavering standards. He believes that meticulous inspection and proactive problem-solving are crucial to achieving consistent performance. His innovative mindset allows him to identify areas for improvement and implement effective solutions, ensuring the team's equipment is always performing at its peak. While his exacting nature can sometimes be perceived as demanding, his commitment to excellence is undeniable.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his foot when concentrating.
Insists on using specific calibration tools, regardless of what's available.
